abstract: We revisit the standard regularity assumption used to ensure uniqueness of the optimal price in monopoly models, namely that the Virtual Value (VV) function is monotone. This condition is typically imposed through strong distributional assumptions, such as log‐concavity, that restrict the model's flexibility and implicitly discipline the sign of comparative statics. We show that these assumptions can be relaxed without compromising tractability or uniqueness. Our main contribution is to introduce ‐Regularity, a weaker condition that requires monotonicity of the VV only beyond the threshold where marginal revenue becomes nonnegative. We demonstrate that many common non‐regular, unimodal distributions satisfy this local condition. This shift in focus allows standard first‐order methods to remain valid, and it enlarges the set of tractable demand primitives in applied IO. As an implication, when hazard rates are not monotone over the relevant pricing range, comparative statics need not follow the direction imposed by log‐concavity. The framework also reduces the need for ironing when modeling with heavy‐tailed demand.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了垄断模型中用于确保最优价格唯一性的标准正则性假设，即虚拟价值函数单调的条件。这一条件通常通过强分布假设（如对数凹性）来施加，但这些假设限制了模型的灵活性，并隐含地约束了比较静态的方向。我们证明，这些假设可以在不牺牲可处理性或唯一性的前提下被放宽。本文的主要贡献在于引入“局部正则性”这一更弱的条件，该条件仅要求虚拟价值函数在边际收入变为非负的阈值之后保持单调。我们证明，许多常见的非正则单峰分布满足这一局部条件。这一视角的转变使得标准的一阶方法仍然有效，并扩大了应用产业组织中可处理的需求基元集合。其含义在于，当风险率在相关定价范围内不单调时，比较静态的方向不必遵循对数凹性所施加的路径。该框架还减少了在建模重尾需求时进行“熨平”处理的必要性。
title: Non‐Regular Distributions, Virtual Values and Monopoly Problems
title_zh: 非正则分布、虚拟价值与垄断问题

abstract: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighborhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighborhood formation, a context characterized by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighborhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighborhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: Enforceable covenants account for 6–24% of the observed neighborhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighborhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.
abstract_zh: 20世纪初，美国住房契约中的种族限制条款被广泛用于实施社区隔离。1948年，最高法院在谢利诉克雷默案中裁定此类条款在法庭上不可强制执行，但并未完全禁止其存在。我们推测，即便失去司法强制力，这些条款仍可能通过充当社区形成初期均衡协调的焦点机制（在投资耐久性与路径依赖特征显著的背景下）影响种族隔离格局。为验证这一假说，我们构建了包含种族限制条款的新型宗地级数据集，并利用条款执行与住房建设之间的时间差设计准实验框架，以识别社区建设时期可执行条款的暴露程度。研究发现，条款的可执行性确实影响了社区形成初期的住房特征、公共基础设施布局及首批居民构成。这些早期差异展现出持久性：可执行条款可解释1980-2020年间观测到的社区种族隔离现象的6-24%，以及21世纪房价差异的3.1-4.4%。我们得出结论：法律通过协调社区形成过程中的信念与决策，催生了远超种族限制条款存续期的空间不平等。
title: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
title_zh: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族契约的证据

abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how --- and when --- institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive--11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019--while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s--a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.
abstract_zh: 解释为何一些国家走向富裕而另一些国家却陷入贫困，需要理解制度如何——以及何时——发生变迁。大量研究认为，制度变迁往往发生在关键节点：即多种制度未来可能并存（包括回归现状）的时刻。然而，多数实证研究仅以回溯方式考察关键节点，这可能导致遗漏制度处于变动中却最终未发生改变的关键时刻。我们开发了一种新的实证方法，用于实时检测正在展开的关键节点。核心洞见在于将关键节点理解为制度不确定性时期——这为文本分类器提供了具有理论依据的检测对象，使其能在同期话语中识别此类时刻。本章中，我们运用这一理念研究历史关键节点，以报纸文本作为反映当时制度不确定性认知的丰富信息源。通过训练基于大语言模型的分类器，我们将这一洞见转化为测量策略，并将其应用于《泰晤士报》档案库（涵盖1800年至2019年的1195万篇文章），同时将主要实证分析聚焦于1900年至2019年间的120年报道。由此产生了首个基于关键节点概念、以文本为基础的长期制度不确定性度量指标。相较于既有的地缘政治与经济风险指数，本指标在多个方面实现创新：（i）即便在未发生正式制度变迁的时期，也能捕捉到高度不确定性，这与关键节点的事前定义一致；（ii）能更早预警重大全球动荡（如第一次世界大战）；（iii）采用统一的事前度量标准评估候选关键节点；（iv）为研究关键节点如何塑造制度与长期发展开辟新路径。当前，基于《泰晤士报》的指数显示，美英两国的制度不确定性已升至与20世纪40年代初相当的水平——这一信号被其他主流风险指标所遗漏。
authors: Michael Callen; Gregory Levy; Saipremnath Muthukumaran; Jonathan Weigel; Noam Yuchtman
title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
title_zh: DP21760 检测正在展开的关键节点：基于120年报道的基础、测量与应用

abstract: We compare the informativeness of order statistics in a sample of conditionally independent draws from a distribution F(x|θ) as the sample size n increases. The k-th highest of n+1 draws is more accurate than the k-th highest of n if and only if the cumulative reverse hazard − log F(x|θ) is log-supermodular. Symmetrically, the k-th lowest is more accurate if and only if the cumulative hazard − log (1−F(x|θ)) is log-supermodular. Reversals are exceptional, occurring only for experiments that are, up to increasing transformations, exponential location experiments. In large samples, middle order statistics are asymptotically fully informative, while bounded lower and upper ranks require unbounded informativeness tail conditions. When full learning fails, bounded ranks converge to location experiments, and more central ranks are Blackwell more informative. Extending the analysis from scalar order statistics to blocks of selected data, we obtain multidimensional comparisons under log-supermodularity of hazard rates. The results unify and extend information-aggregation results in auctions and provide a new order-statistic approach to strategic voting.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了在条件独立抽样分布F(x|θ)中，随着样本量n增大，顺序统计量的信息含量。当且仅当累积逆风险函数−log F(x|θ)为对数超模时，n+1次抽样中的第k高顺序统计量比n次抽样中的第k高顺序统计量更精确。对称地，当且仅当累积风险函数−log (1−F(x|θ))为对数超模时，第k低顺序统计量更精确。反转情况极为罕见，仅出现在经过递增变换后等价于指数位置实验的实验中。在大样本条件下，中间顺序统计量渐近地具有完全信息含量，而有限的下界和上界秩次则需要无界信息含量尾部条件。当完全学习失效时，有界秩次收敛于位置实验，且更中心的秩次在Blackwell意义上具有更高信息含量。将分析从标量顺序统计量扩展至选定数据块后，我们在风险率对数超模条件下获得了多维比较结果。这些结论统一并拓展了拍卖中的信息聚合结果，并为策略性投票提供了新的顺序统计量分析方法。
authors: Alfredo Di Tillio; Marco Ottaviani; Peter Sørensen
title: Information Comparison of Order Statistics, with Applications to Auctions and Voting
title_zh: DP21759 顺序统计量的信息比较及其在拍卖与投票中的应用

abstract: In 2025, only 60% of Americans believed in human-caused climate change, despite a strong consensus in the scientific community. This paper argues that motivated reasoning contributes to climate-change ignorance. Using a difference-in-differences design we show that layoffs in the coal-mining sector increases the share of believers in climate change. Comparing layoffs in coal mining to manufacturing confirms that the effect is specific to employment in the fossil fuel industry. Finally, we find no comparable shifts in beliefs on unrelated policy issues, suggesting that changes in climate views reflect specific self-image dynamics rather than a broader opinion shifts.
abstract_zh: 2025年，尽管科学界已形成强烈共识，但仅有60%的美国人相信人类活动导致气候变化。本文论证了动机性推理是造成气候变化认知缺失的原因之一。通过双重差分法设计，我们发现煤炭开采行业的裁员提高了气候变化信仰者的比例。将煤炭开采业裁员与制造业裁员进行对比，证实该效应仅针对化石燃料行业的就业情况。最后，我们在无关政策议题上未发现类似信念转变，这表明气候变化观点的变化反映了特定的自我形象动态，而非更广泛的意见转变。
title: Facing the Hard Truth: Evidence from Climate Change Ignorance

abstract: There is growing evidence that place-based industrial policies lead to positive economic effects. This column analyses the “Million-Rouble Plants” programme of the 1950s when the Soviet Union helped China build state-of-the-art industrial facilities. By tracking the locations that benefitted, it finds positive economic spillovers in the short and medium run. Although the Million-Rouble Plants themselves continued to thrive, the performance of other local establishments eventually declined, as increasing specialisation weakened knowledge spillovers and constrained local entrepreneurship. Policymakers may achieve more durable gains by fostering diversified local production structures that encourage knowledge spillovers, labour market resilience, and adaptation to technological and market shocks.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，地方性产业政策能够带来积极的经济效应。本文分析了20世纪50年代苏联帮助中国建设先进工业设施的“百万卢布工厂”计划。通过追踪受益地区，研究发现该计划在短期和中期内产生了正向经济溢出效应。尽管“百万卢布工厂”本身持续繁荣，但其他本地企业的绩效最终出现下滑，原因在于日益增强的专业化削弱了知识溢出效应，并限制了本地创业活力。政策制定者若想实现更持久的收益，应培育多元化的地方生产结构，以促进知识溢出、增强劳动力市场韧性，并提升应对技术与市场冲击的适应能力。
authors: Stephan Heblich, Marlon Seror, Yanos Zylberberg
